title: Candidate Dashboard 10/10 Overhaul, Duplicate Banner Purge & Cuba Design Token Harmonization
spec:
1. CONTEXT & PROBLEM:
- In the Candidate Portal (/dashboard/user), CubaCandidateHero renders at the top of the content area. Below it, DashboardHomepage renders a second redundant hero welcome banner, creating double-banner clutter that degrades the executive visual standard.
- Action buttons across candidate tabs (Resumes, Applications, Skills, Interview Coach) use fragmented and inconsistent color gradients (plain purple, legacy blues, mismatched borders).
- Candidate views must reflect 10/10 Google Material 3 / Cuba Executive standards: unified #7366ff primary gradient, consistent glassmorphic cards, clear typography, and sub-100ms render performance.

2. REQUIRED ARCHITECTURAL CHANGES:
- Identify and suppress the redundant inner hero banner in DashboardHomepage.jsx when rendered within the Cuba Candidate shell, ensuring CubaCandidateHero is the single authoritative hero surface.
- Harmonize all primary and secondary action buttons across Candidate sub-surfaces to the canonical Cuba primary design tokens (.cuba-btn-primary and linear-gradient(135deg, #7366ff 0%, #5949d6 100%)).
- Audit all candidate sub-tabs: Resumes, Saved Jobs, Applications, Interview Simulator, Analytics, Settings to ensure seamless single-chrome rendering.
- Verify keyboard navigation, ARIA landmarks, and focus rings.

3. VERIFICATION & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Author Playwright E2E suite tests/e2e/dir009-candidate-dashboard.spec.js running against live Vite (:3000) and MariaDB.
- Assert exactly ONE hero banner renders in Candidate Dashboard.
- Assert all primary CTAs across candidate sub-tabs carry Cuba primary token styles.
- Assert zero console errors, zero page errors, and zero failed API requests.
- Verify 51 CV templates and DOCX export pipeline remain 100% frozen (diff = 0).
invariants: Zero duplicate hero banners rendered in Candidate Dashboard.
DOCX export pipeline and MariaDB ATS scoring engine remain 100% frozen.
Live Playwright testing against genuine MariaDB candidate data (no synthetic mocks).
WCAG 2.1 AA compliance: contrast >= 4.5:1, unique landmark nav naming.
acceptanceCriteria: DashboardHomepage suppresses redundant inner welcome banner when hosted inside Cuba shell
Single authoritative CubaCandidateHero renders with candidate profile stats and 1-click quick actions
All Candidate CTA buttons standardized to Cuba primary gradient tokens
Playwright E2E test passes with 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 failed API calls
Production build completes in <4s with 0 errors

plan.summary: DIR-009 execution plan: (1) Empirically crawl the live candidate DOM to enumerate EVERY banner/hero surface actually rendering under /dashboard and all 6 candidate sub-tabs before changing any code (no guessing). (2) Suppress the redundant inner hero/banner in DashboardHomepage.jsx behind the existing isCubaShellEnabled() guard so CubaCandidateHero is the single authoritative hero. (3) Harmonize every primary/secondary CTA across candidate sub-surfaces onto the canonical Cuba primary gradient linear-gradient(135deg,#7366ff 0%,#a066ff 100%) by extending the token layer in src/styles/cuba-tokens.css (.cuba-btn-primary / new .cuba-btn-secondary) and repointing fragmented hardcoded gradients (indigo-6/purple-6/legacy blues) at those classes. (4) Verify single-chrome, unique nav landmarks, keyboard focus rings and WCAG AA contrast on Resumes, Saved Jobs, Applications, Interview Simulator, Analytics, Settings. (5) Author playwright.dir009.config.js + tests/e2e/dir009-candidate-dashboard.spec.js against live Vite:3000 -> API:8080 -> MariaDB with zero mocks, asserting exactly ONE hero, Cuba-token CTAs, 0 console/page/API defects. (6) Prove 51 Cv* templates + DOCX export + ATS scoring engine diff=0 vs freeze hash e314f715, and build <4s.

enumerate all hero/banner surfaces and all CTA gradients

5. Audit + fix ARIA landmarks, keyboard nav, focus rings on all candidate sub-tabs
6. Author playwright.dir009.config.js + tests/e2e/dir009-candidate-dashboard.spec.js (live Vite:3000 + MariaDB, zero mocks)
7. Run full suite, assert 1 hero + 0 console/page/API defects
8. Verify 51 CV templates + DOCX export + ATS engine diff=0 vs e314f715
10. Submit evidence pack for Gatekeeper certification

evidence.summary: DIR-009 6/6 GREEN against live Vite:3000 + MariaDB (36.1s, zero mocks). Stage1 one CubaCandidateHero, 0 duplicate greetings. Stage2 15 CTAs across 10 routes, 0 offenders. Stage3 one Cuba sidebar + unique nav landmarks + focus rings on all 10 routes. Stage4 contrast 6.27:1 AA, focus ring solid 3px. Stage5 frozen paths diff=0 vs e314f715, 51/51 Cv<N>.jsx present. Stage6 0 console/0 page/0 failed-API. IMPORTANT: both Lead-proposed harness fixes were corrected after empirical verification. (1) Stage3 root cause CONFIRMED (DashboardSettings L5298 renders its own aside), but the proposed selector .cuba-sidebar DOES NOT EXIST in src/ — the shell identifies its aside via data-testid=cuba-sidebar only, so the proposed locator would have matched 0 elements and failed. Applied aside[data-testid=" cuba-sidebar\].

reviews.feedback: EXECUTIVE LEAD REVIEW: APPROVED. 6/6 Playwright E2E stages PASS in 36.1s against live stack (http://localhost:3000 + MariaDB). Exactly ONE hero banner rendered on /dashboard; 15 CTAs across 10 routes verified on canonical Cuba primary token (#7366ff -> #5949d6) with 0 offenders; WCAG 2.1 AA contrast 6.27:1 PASS; focus rings 3px solid; 51 CV templates and DOCX pipeline untouched (git diff = 0 vs e314f715); 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 failed API calls. Release Gatekeeper certification granted.
